notes: All six pages have exactly one Common Crawl snapshot each; sourceUrl is the index lookup address from each file footer and sourceDate is the capture timestamp's date. (1) Smeal SCIS 'Recent Placements' (2013-05-19): 24 rows from a Year|Name|Employer|Position table headed 'Supply Chain Placement'; the year is a placement year (all positions 'Assistant Professor'), not a stated graduation year; names kept surname-first. (2) Smeal 'Job Market Candidates' (2019-02-22): 12 candidates across Accounting, Finance, Real Estate, Marketing, Management & Organization and Supply Chain & Information Systems; the page gives no year, so listedYear is null with yearMeaning 'job-market' (the capture date implies the 2018-19 market); research interests kept in note, emails omitted. Only Caroline Swift and Liang (Leon) Xu are in the SC&IS department. (3) Smeal Marketing 'Ph.D. Student Alumni' (2013-05-26): 15 narrative items; the year is the stated job start (fall/January of that year) and three people (Simon Blanchard, Crystal Scott, Girish Mallapragada) have no year. Marketing, not operations. (4)/(5) Krannert 'Alumni Achievements' (2013-06-20 and 2019-02-16): achievement profiles and news, not a placement list. Years are stated PhD completion years where the profile spells out 'PhD ..., YEAR'; Sriram's '(Marketing, 2004)' is left 'unstated'. Destinations/positions are affiliations at capture time or later moves (two university presidencies), never stated first jobs, so the integrator should not treat them as placements. Karel Cool and Jack Hughes appear with only award text in the 2013 snapshot; Cool's profile with PhD 1985 appears only in 2019. None of these alumni is in operations management. (6) Krannert 'Distinguished PhD Alum' Abel Jeuland (2013-05-25): single-person page giving only his current chair at Chicago Booth; no year or program. No snapshot was unreadable. Nothing in this chunk names an operations/supply chain doctoral graduate with a stated graduation year; the SCIS table gives placement years only.
